test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fe72d54b470d78cb512e72f1773515a081ba510f02afb8238093abe1af53bf1.png]
solution:
Explanation:

Logic: If two dice have the same two face values in the given image, then the third number is opposite to each other.

In given figure 1 and 3, **1 and 2 are common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1e8947c28707c478c560eaeaaeddbfc0bb08407d2d29d6e03e653e7607f50de.png] 

So, the number opposite to 4 is 6.

Hence, **6** is the correct answer.
